question: Why does the Haber–Bosch process, as described in the lithium-mediated ammonia review, run at pressures of only 1-5 atm?
rendered: The Haber–Bosch process is not described in the review as running at pressures of only 1-5 atm. The review states that the Haber–Bosch process runs at "extreme temperatures (400–650 °C) and pressures (200–400 atm)" (Pathways to sustainable lithium-mediated ammonia electrosynthesis: tuning reaction environment and advancing reactor design, page 1).
